numbering_policy: Original Saints references, chapters, reading sections, anchors and continuation bodies are preserved. Missing original verse numbers are not filled from another edition.
review_notes: All 112 actual original John source units in chapters 1–3 were read with their complete local scenes: 51 in chapter 1, 25 in chapter 2 and 36 in chapter 3. There are 102 proposed paired sources, 105 pairs and 10 explicit deferrals.

Every retained target was read in the exact pinned Saints cache with relevant surrounding context. Source and target wording, original divisions, IDs, gaps and continuation bodies are preserved. The proposals do not establish new critical-text approval or replace the source's provisional editorial status.

The syntax crossing John 1:3–4 remains intact: the final words of 1:3 continue into 1:4. Comparisons do not substitute the familiar alternative division or silently normalize the supplied grace-in-place-of-grace and only-begotten-God wording.

Creation, incarnation, divine childhood and Father-Son revelation comparisons identify actual shared clauses while preserving each passage's distinct vocabulary. They are passage relationships, not a new harmonized paraphrase or a fresh systematic doctrinal ruling.

Baptist testimony comparisons distinguish witnesses, speakers, vision descriptions, the Spirit's remaining in John versus Mark's into wording, and Spirit baptism versus Matthew's additional fire. John's Elijah denial is retained alongside Luke's spirit-and-power description rather than rewritten.

The title Prophet is compared with Deuteronomy as background, and Isaiah 40:3 is a named quotation. Genesis 28:12 supplies the angels' ascending-and-descending pattern without adding a literal ladder to John's plural promise. Psalms use the exact Greek-OT IDs 31:2, 2:6–7 and 68:10.

Calling and recognition accounts retain different participants and occasions. Cephas/Peter and son-of-John versus Bar-Jonah are not silently harmonized. Philip's son-of-Joseph wording remains reported speech, and perceived-origin objections remain characters' claims rather than endorsed geographic conclusions.

Internal references expressly mark repeated testimony, translated forms of address, a later participant identification, recalled location or sign, clarification of baptismal agency, and recurring teaching. They are not additional independent witnesses or extra events.

Cana comparisons preserve the actual mother, servants, feast-master, bridegroom, vessels and differing kinds of provision. The servants' knowing is not made a statement that no one else knows. The beginning/second-sign notices do not remove the intervening Jerusalem signs reported by the same Gospel.

Temple accounts retain different narrative placements, action lists and interpretations of God's house. The supplied Psalm 68:10 past expression and John's future citation are distinguished. Mark's false-witness allegation is not substituted for Jesus' Destroy-this-sanctuary saying or its stated bodily explanation.

Nicodemus comparisons distinguish divine birth from his physical-womb objection. Ezekiel's water/new-Spirit promise is qualified background, not an asserted direct quotation or a complete ruling on ritual interpretation. Ecclesiastes' spirit and womb imagery is read as supplied beside John's wind/Spirit illustration.

Wisdom of Solomon 9:16–17 supplies the verified earthly/heavenly knowledge contrast and the Holy Spirit from on high. Numbers 21:8–9 supplies the explicit lifted-serpent episode, with physical looking-and-living distinguished from John's ensuing belief-and-eternal-life application.

Saving-purpose and judgment statements are compared together without deleting either. Rejection formulas are kept alongside the text's explicit receivers, and believing, disobeying, having the Son and receiving testimony keep their respective verbs. No fixed afterlife geography or universal failure of every sign-believer is inferred.

Pronouns and speech boundaries follow the supplied edition: the we/you-all testimony formula is not reassigned to a speculative set of speakers, and John 3:31–36 is not newly attributed across the source's unquoted boundary.

Target IDs, original-contiguous ranges, exact source coverage, unique directed pairs and exclusion of self targets are checked before handoff. This is English passage review rather than an exhaustive concordance, independent human specialist approval or live destination-anchor verification.

Read all100 original source units in John4–5 after the recorded completion of all1149 Luke source units. Read every retained actual target passage with surrounding context; reused targets were not credited as new source reviews.

John5:4 is absent in the original and remains absent. The stirred-water statement in5:7 is not supplemented by an angel account. John8:11 retains its actual closing bracket as target evidence; no new critical-text judgment is claimed.

Psalm121 and Nehemiah and all other source divisions follow the Saints Greek-based inventory. Narrative comparisons retain the distinct royal official/son, centurion/slave, Jairus/daughter and separate Sabbath patients.
Internal references and contrasts are labeled as such, not offered as independent testimony. Named sites and unnamed witnesses are not assigned unsupported identities.
This is supplied-English passage comparison, without new Greek/Hebrew apparatus verification, exhaustive concordance or independent human specialist approval.

The full 878-unit John source inventory was prepared with zero completion credit after all original Luke units were read. Only individually reviewed source units with supported retained connections earn completion credit.

All 21 saved John deferrals from the delivered John 1–5 scope were reread in actual source context. The actual deferred IDs fall in chapters 1–4. Eighteen have newly proposed bounded connections and three remain deferred with zero completion credit.

Each case separately preserves its previous reason, the SHA-256 of its exact UTF-8 original source text, and an individual current assessment. Source text, IDs, display wording, divisions, gaps and continuations were not edited.

The earlier reasons properly rule out identities, exact duplicate events or missing biographical details. The new proposals instead identify specific supported inquiry/report structures, participant references, wine quality contrasts, literal-misunderstanding patterns, baptismal settings and Samaritan journey contrasts without claiming to resolve the unverified details.

Pharisees in the baptismal ministry are compared as different narrated contexts, not the same envoys or a uniform personal history. Andrew's identification clarifies the earlier pair, leaving the second disciple unnamed. Capernaum visits retain their different duration and narrative placement.

Good wine retained until late is compared with the old-is-good saying without changing good into better, assigning covenant identities or approving a new historical feast custom. The forty-six-year question is compared as a misunderstanding of the body's temple referent, not externally verified construction chronology.

Mary's conception question and Nicodemus's later question are compared in their distinct Spirit-and-birth conversations. Virgin conception and the hearers' new birth, their order and reactions, remain different. Aenon, Salim and Bethany are not equated or assigned modern coordinates or a new baptismal technique.

The two Samaritan journeys have different directions and community responses. John 4's had-to force remains unresolved. Bodily need and drink recur across the well and passion scenes without supplying Jacob's spring identity, an identical sixth hour, a medical mechanism or an unreported drink at the well.

The disciples' departure, return and food appeal form an internal narrative frame. The woman's truthful no-husband answer is explicitly explained by the following statement; truth of the answer is not a new moral approval of an unstated relationship or a reconstruction of divorce, widowhood or sexual history.

No names or allegorical identities are supplied for the five husbands or the present person not called her husband. Prior personal knowledge and responses about Jesus' identity are compared with Nathanael's distinct story rather than a fabricated shared biography.

The actual Genesis 24 well/report/listener-response pattern provides a limited narrative analogy. It does not identify Jesus as the servant, the Samaritan woman as Rebekah, or the water jar as renounced possessions, and does not turn the encounter into an explicitly narrated betrothal.

Unspoken observer responses are compared without equating the women or transferring Luke's sinner label to John's woman. The food invitation's reversed roles and the water/food misunderstandings retain their different images, hearers and literal meal versus mission contexts.
The three unresolved cases remain deferred after specific reconsideration. No comparison is retained merely to raise a quota or supply an independent witness that the actual target does not contain.

All retained actual targets and context were read from the unchanged pinned Saints cache. Exact target IDs and original-contiguous ranges, all 21 source cases, unique directed pairs, source/target exclusion, preserved old reasons and exact source hashes are checked before handoff.

Read every retained actual target against the exact pinned Saints originals, commit 328967336f32958587835c921fea3b96a5bf6494, with surrounding context. Verified all IDs, original-order target contiguity, directed-key uniqueness, no source self-targets, and complete disjoint source coverage.

Internal links are explicitly literary recurrences, recaps, contrasts, or image developments within this Gospel, never independent historical attestations. Reported accusations, destination guesses, prayer arguments, and other character speech retain their speakers.

Possible finger-writing and divine-name allusions are qualified rather than treated as exact quotations or proofs of unspecified contents. Bread/flesh/blood, Spirit, light, freedom, household, and shepherd figures are compared without imposing one sacramental, metaphysical, or rigid allegorical solution.

Retained the actual Greek-based numbering and names, including Exodus 20:13 for adultery and 20:15 for murder, Psalms 22 and 81, Micah 5:1, and Joshua's Achar. Other Gospel episodes keep their different persons, settings, procedures, and wording.

Read all 236 actual source units in order: John 11 has 57, John 12 has 50, John 13 has 38, John 14 has 31, John 15 has 27 and John 16 has 33. Every retained actual target was read with surrounding context from the exact pinned Saints cache. No source wording, identifiers, divisions or continuations were changed.

Supported distinct-source counts are separate from pair totals. John16:17 has two clause-specific targets for its composite quotation but earns one source completion; all eight explicit deferrals earn zero credit.

Lazarus of Bethany, brother of Mary and Martha, is not identified with Luke's parable Lazarus. The sisters' repeated sayings, four-day notices, love statements, glory-purpose statements and later raising recaps are explicitly internal links rather than independent corroboration.

Jesus' sleep/death language is read with John's own explanation. The raising's burial cloths and stone are compared with the later Jesus-tomb account without identifying the graves, conflating raising modes, or supplying medical timing and diagnoses.

Judean danger, withdrawals, feast journeys and leader plots retain their particular speakers, locations and sequences. An earlier glory statement is not assumed to have been spoken directly to Martha when its original audience is unnamed.

The Bethany anointing comparisons preserve Mary's name, feet, hair and litra, versus Mark's unnamed woman, head, alabaster jar and Simon the leper's house. Luke's unnamed anointing woman is not identified as Mary. John's six-day arrival notice and Mark's two-day feast preface are not used to force a merged meal date.

Judas's money-box role and the narrator's theft judgment are distinguished from disciples' guesses. Devil-instilled intention, Satan-entry, morsel, departure and the various betrayal accounts keep their actual agencies and timing.

Entry quotations preserve King of Israel and palms, the actual Psalm117 blessing and Zechariah9:9's beast-of-burden/young-colt, rejoice/proclaim and additional attributes. Daniel7 retains the supplied Greek-based son-of-man/Ancient-of-Days formulation without substituting another edition's wording.

Isaiah53:1 and6:10 are read in the actual Saints text. John's He-blinded/hardened formulation differs from Isaiah's heart-grown-dull, heavy-hearing and people-closed-eyes wording; neither agency is rewritten to match the other. John's application of Isaiah's glory vision is labeled as John's application.

Psalm40:10 actually says loaves and magnified treachery, not the Gospel's bread and lifted heel. Psalm68:5 retains its additional unjust-pursuit and repayment clauses. Their actual numbering and full units remain intact.

The foot-washing comparisons preserve different servants, masters, guests and tasks.1Corinthians6:11 actually says you washed yourselves clean before its passive sanctified/justified clauses; its agency is not rewritten to duplicate Jesus washing Peter.

The loved supper disciple remains unnamed. John21's explicit chest-reclining/question retrospect is linked without assigning a name not stated there. Peter's pledges, differing denial-prediction order and Mark's two crows remain distinct.

Father, Son and Spirit remain the stated agents: Jesus asks, the Father gives/sends, Jesus also promises sending from the Father, and the Spirit teaches, reminds, testifies, hears and announces as each passage actually says. No additional procession formula or unmentioned identity is inserted.

Request promises retain their actual addresses: ask Me and I will do versus ask the Father and He gives. John's asking-Me-nothing and I-do-not-say-I-will-ask formulations are not silently rewritten into a harmonized prayer system.

Father greater than I, knowing/seeing Father through Jesus, shared possessions and mutual indwelling retain their exact formulations and contexts. The comparisons do not collapse persons or supply an extra doctrinal ruling.

Vine comparisons distinguish Jesus/disciples/Father from Jeremiah's planted people-vine and Ezekiel's judged Jerusalem vinewood. Wholly genuine, burned yearly prunings, Amos's revealed discipline, and Isaiah26's labor image are the actual supplied words, not remembered alternate editions.

Love, commandment keeping, friendship, fruit, joy, world-hatred and revelation-guilt recurrences are specifically labeled. Different conditional directions, audiences and object words remain distinct; world is not assigned to a whole ethnicity and unbelief statements do not erase the same Gospel's Jewish believers.

Later sight and joy, apostolic works and narrated abandonment are specific comparable outcomes, not exhaustive fulfillment of every word, a universal miracle ranking, or an invented schedule for all coming/going sayings.

This is AI-assisted supplied-English passage review, not exhaustive concordance, fresh original-language apparatus verification, independent human specialist approval, a medical diagnosis, or live destination-anchor verification.

All 164 actual original John units in chapters 17–21 were read in source order: 26, 40, 42, 31 and 25. The proposal contains 158 supported source units, 161 pairs and 6 explicit deferrals. No extra continuation bodies occur in the assigned source chapter or verse fields.

Every retained target and its relevant scene or argument context was read from the exact pinned Saints cache. Target IDs, contiguous original ranges, full source coverage, duplicate directed pairs and self-target exclusion are verified before handoff. Original wording, divisions, gaps, IDs and continuation material are unchanged.

The prayer's Father-given name, people, words, glory, work, protection, unity and love recur in specific farewell passages. The comparisons preserve pronouns and scopes without equating every type of unity or resolving a new systematic account of preexistence, election or divine relations.

John 10:29 retains the supplied What-My-Father-has-given-Me formulation; Matthew 6:13 says evil while John 17:15 says evil one. Neither is replaced with a familiar alternative reading. Intercession for the immediate disciples is not expanded into a denial of the same prayer's concern for the world's belief.

The garden arrest retains Kidron, the group descriptions, Jesus' questions, the fall, Peter and Malchus, and the permitted departure request. John's I-am repetitions are compared internally without claiming a verbatim Exodus divine-name quotation or adding a Judas kiss that this account does not narrate.

The unnamed disciple known to the high priest is not automatically identified with the beloved disciple. Annas, Caiaphas, the high-priest questions and the later transfer remain in the supplied sequence. Peter's accusers, postures, denial words and rooster notice retain their differences from the other Gospels.

Trial comparisons distinguish reported allegations from narrator assertions, including the claims about wrongdoing, tribute, sonship, kingship and Caesar. Divine derivation of authority does not erase the greater-sin statement or name its otherwise unnamed hander-over. No external execution-law reconstruction is approved by the textual comparisons.

John's about-sixth-hour presentation and Mark's third-hour crucifixion are explicitly compared without a clock conversion. Purple and scarlet descriptions, cross-carrying by Jesus and by Simon, and different public or private stages remain visible without invented handoff points, extra scourgings or textile explanations.

The inscription texts, languages and attributed authorship remain as supplied. This Luke 23:38 unit does not include the three-language clause. Proposed editing of the inscription is compared with the actual Jesus-Pilate exchange as an accusers' formulation, not silently adopted as Jesus' verbatim speech.

Clothing comparisons distinguish four garment parts from the seamless tunic, the later lying linen from the separately wrapped face cloth, and Lazarus's still-bound wrappings. No folded-napkin custom, fresh medical explanation or universalized burial sequence is added.

Greek-OT Psalm IDs are exact: 21:19 for clothing lots, 68:22 for thirst and sour wine, 33:21 for guarded bones, 26:2 for falling assailants and 118:160 for true words. Psalm 33:21 speaks of their bones in the plural. Exodus 12:46 supplies possible Passover bone background without claiming a uniquely proved quotation source.

Zechariah 12:10 retains look toward Me because they danced in mockery and mourning, while John 19:37 retains look on the One whom they pierced. The connection is expressly qualified as possible citation background with a wording mismatch; the Old Testament target is not rewritten to match a different edition.

Resurrection comparisons preserve women's names and numbers as narrated, darkness versus risen-sun descriptions, initial body-removal assumptions versus later encounter reports, two seated angels versus Luke's standing men, the different messages, and invitations versus narrated contact.

Peter and the other disciple retain distinct arrival, entry, belief and later recognition roles. John 20:8's unstated belief object and the following not-yet-Scripture understanding are not collapsed. Thomas is explicitly absent then present; the proposed touching is not asserted to have been performed.

The target Mark 16:9–11 is part of the supplied bracketed longer ending. Its existing provisional source-limitation status is retained; this pair is passage review of the provided text, not new specialist or apparatus approval of that ending.

Jesus' breathing is compared with Genesis' creative breath as a qualified image, and forgiveness/retention with the separate binding/loosing wording as a bounded responsibility comparison. Neither comparison supplies a new ritual procedure or resolves all subsequent interpretations of the Spirit or the commission.

The earlier and later fish catches remain separate: nights, commands, boats, nets beginning to tear versus an unbroken net, 153 fish, and the after-resurrection setting are preserved. Peter ties his outer garment before entering the sea; no walking-on-water event is inserted into this scene.

The charcoal-fire recurrence is a literary setting link rather than the same fire. Bread-and-fish distribution and resurrection meals retain who asks, supplies, receives and explicitly eats. John's third group-revelation marker does not become an exclusive count of every appearance.

The three love questions and the feed/shepherd/lambs/sheep formulations remain as supplied English. More than these is not assigned a definite comparison object, and no fresh Greek love-word hierarchy, one-for-one absolution formula, inverted crucifixion detail or date for Peter's death is added.

The beloved disciple's supper reference, the conditional remaining saying and its rumor correction are explicit internal links. The condition is not changed into an immortality promise, and the testimony's plural we and concluding I are not assigned a newly verified editorial identity.
